name: micro-frontend-common
description: 範例：Host 以 Module Federation 載入獨立 Common remote，同 DOM 掛載

scripts.dev: concurrently -n common,host -c magenta,blue "npm run dev:remote" "npm run dev:host"
scripts.dev:remote: npm run build -w common && concurrently -n build,serve -c gray,magenta "npm run build:watch -w common" "npm run preview -w common"
scripts.build: npm run build -w common && npm run build -w host
scripts.preview: concurrently -n common,host -c magenta,blue "npm run preview -w common" "npm run preview -w host"
